_comment: Per-service count of operations declaring a response body. RATCHET: these only go up. Raise them with --update after declaring more; a change that lowers one fails the build. See check-response-schemas.py for why this is a floor and not a target.

_lowered.emr: 32.6 — 28 → 27. GET /encounters/queue was RETIRED (see the note in services/emr/Api/Program.cs): it presented the encounter's open/closed bookkeeping as a waiting room, listing people who had already been called through, under `.RequireAuthorization()` with no scope. One fewer described operation because there is one fewer operation — not because an endpoint stopped describing itself. A floor lowered for that reason is recorded here so the next reader does not have to reconstruct it from the git history.
